gain.rule: among navtest scenes where every C seed's official EPDMS (human filter) is above R's, the one with the largest gain on its worst seed

loss.rule: among navtest scenes where every C seed's official EPDMS is below R's, the one with the largest loss on its best seed

ddc.rule: among R-clean's known-command windows where the release's pick passes DDC (vendored, the human passing too) and C seeds 0 and 1 both fail it, the one with the largest city weight, then the largest loss on seed 0

gain.rule: among navtest scenes where HD's official EPDMS (human filter) is above D's on every paired seed, the one with the largest mean gain

loss.rule: among navtest scenes where HD's official EPDMS is below D's on every paired seed, the one with the largest mean loss
